content: - On April 5, 2024, Kairos International Sicav - European Long Only* merged into Kairos International Sicav - ActivESG, based on the NAV date April 4, 2024.
As at April 15, 2024, the Sub-Fund Kairos International Sicav - European Long/Short has changed its name in Kairos International Sicav - Opportunities Long/Short*.
